required_documents.name: Form I-9
required_documents.rationale: Federal law requires identity and work authorization verification within 3 business days of start.

required_documents.name: IP Assignment Agreement
required_documents.rationale: Assigns work-product IP to the company.

required_documents.name: Benefits Enrollment
required_documents.rationale: Health insurance and 401(k) elections; 30-day enrollment window.

required_documents.name: Contractor MSA
required_documents.rationale: Master services agreement defines scope and terms.

required_documents.name: IP Assignment Agreement
required_documents.rationale: Contractors must explicitly assign IP — no default work-for-hire status.

required_documents.name: Right to Work check
required_documents.rationale: UK law requires Right to Work verification before start date.

required_documents.name: Employment Contract
required_documents.rationale: Must be issued before or on the first day.

required_documents.name: Pension Auto-enrollment
required_documents.rationale: UK statutory auto-enrollment for workplace pension.

required_documents.name: Right to Work check
required_documents.rationale: Required even for contractors under UK law.

required_documents.name: IR35 Status Determination
required_documents.rationale: Determines whether the contractor is inside or outside IR35 for tax purposes.

executive_addons.name: Equity Grant Agreement
executive_addons.rationale: Documents stock option or RSU grant; board-approved.

executive_addons.name: Post-Employment Restrictions
executive_addons.rationale: Non-compete and non-solicit covenants where legally enforceable.

sensitive_data_role_addons.name: Sensitive Data Access Agreement
sensitive_data_role_addons.rationale: Additional controls for roles touching PII, financial, or legal data.

fallback_behavior: If the hire's location.country is not in known_jurisdictions, the Compliance Agent MUST surface an `escalation` HITL gate with proposed_decision='unfamiliar_combination', a best-effort proposed document set based on closest known jurisdiction, and rationale explaining the uncertainty. Do not silently default.
